title: AlgedonicRecoveredFeedbackSignal
description: FeedbackSignal kind emitted when an open algedonic signal (approach and/or breach) has cleared: the stock stayed on the safe side of the reset line for the full dwell. Recovered is a transition of the algedonic latch, never an incident state. Emitted at most once per recovery; the latch keys are cleared by it, so a stock re-crossing the reset line during dwell cancels the recovery instead of emitting. standing_impact is fixed 'advisory' — the signal informs, it does not itself withdraw or restore standing. Canon: genesis/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-30-dialogue-stasis-loop-design.md (AlgedonicSignal and its latch) and genesis/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-10-algedonic-feedback-signal-design.md §3.
$comment: Source of truth: DHT (FeedbackSignal entry); this file is the wire contract only.

target.description: CID of the promise (Commitment) whose pain has cleared.

declarer.description: CID or agent identifier of the agent that declared the original pain and now declares its recovery.

stock.description: The measured stock level when recovery was confirmed.

bound_ref.description: CID of the bounding commitment/manifest that declared the limit.

reset_pct.description: The reset line as a percentage of the limit (limit x reset_pct / 100). Below it is safe for a ceiling bound; above it is safe for a floor bound.

crossed_back_at.description: When the stock last crossed back to the safe side of the reset line and stayed there for the dwell.

dwell_s.description: Seconds the stock had to remain on the safe side before the latch reset.

cause_ref.description: Reference to the event that moved the stock back (for a dialogue stall, the incident's closing event).
